title: #252 Travel with Friends
prompt: Some people like to travel with friends, while others prefer to travel alone. Which one would you prefer?

promptSegments.text: Some people like to travel with friends, while others prefer to travel alone.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Group travel is fun because friends share activities and make memories together.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Group travel is fun because friends share activities and make memories together.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Solo travel is good for self-knowledge because it allows the person to move at their own speed.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Solo travel is good for self-knowledge because it allows the person to move at their own speed.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traveling with friends is a good option because it is fun and helps share costs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traveling with friends is a good option because it is fun and helps share costs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Traveling alone is also good because it gives people time for themselves.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traveling alone is also good because it gives people time for themselves.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Group travel provides companionship and shared moments, making the experience enjoyable and supportive.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Group travel provides companionship and shared moments, making the experience enjoyable and supportive.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Solo travel offers personal freedom and self-discovery, allowing individuals to control their own time and plans.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Solo travel offers personal freedom and self-discovery, allowing individuals to control their own time and plans.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traveling with friends offers companionship and support, making the journey better and simplifying the planning process for everyone involved.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traveling with friends offers companionship and support, making the journey better and simplifying the planning process for everyone involved.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Traveling alone allows for deep freedom and self-discovery because the traveler makes all decisions, promoting trust in one's own judgment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traveling alone allows for deep freedom and self-discovery because the traveler makes all decisions, promoting trust in one's own judgment.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
